artworks.title: Five Male Nudes Gesticulating as a Nude Woman Enters a Portal
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown ink over graphite on light tan wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting expressive figures in dynamic poses. On the left, a solitary figure extends its arm, with vertical lines suggesting motion or a barrier. On the right, a group of figures with exaggerated musculature and expressive gestures add a sense of drama and tension. In the lower center, a smaller head observes or reacts to the scene.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies with a Soldier Drawing a Sword, a Crucifix, Monstrous Animals, and Other Figures
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 13.8 x 13.3 cm (5 7/16 x 5 1/4 in.), all corners cut
mount: 15.5 x 18.1 cm (6 1/8 x 7 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various abstract figures and elements, including a crucifixion, a demon-like figure, and multiple human forms. The full description of the artwork includes a loosely sketched crucifixion scene in the upper left corner. In the center, a muscular figure wearing a helmet and holding a spear stands prominently. To the upper right, a figure with horned features appears suspended or floating, its body abstract and elongated. Below this, a large, expressive face with exaggerated features stares to the left. In the bottom center, several smaller human forms are seen in various stances, holding sticks or spears. The entire drawing is composed with free-flowing lines and appears to explore dynamic poses and interactions.

artworks.title: Apollo and Daphne
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on green-blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a figure reaching out towards another figure in the process of transforming into a tree. The figure on the left is shown with their arms raised as they transform; their hands are extending and turning into branches with leaves sprouting. The posture and lines indicate movement and transformation. The right figure appears to be interacting with the transforming one. The drawing focuses on the central figures and their interaction, with a minimal background.

artworks.title: Washerwomen
artworks.medium: etching [counterproof] reworked with pen and black ink, black and white chalk, and gray wash
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of women in a landscape. The women are gathered near a body of water, possibly engaging in a communal activity. They are dressed in clothing that suggests an earlier time period, including head coverings and long dresses. The background features trees and possibly a mountain or hills. The drawing utilizes soft shading and delicate lines to create a sense of depth and texture in both the figures and the surrounding environment. The image captures a serene and harmonious interaction between the figures and nature, highlighting traditional rural life.

artworks.title: A Reclining Male Nude
artworks.medium: black chalk with stumping, heightened with white chalk and touches of pink chalk on wove paper washed dark olive-green
artworks.description: The image shows a naked male figure lying on his side, with his head resting against a surface. He has short curly hair and a muscular build. The background is a plain textured surface. No objects or jewelry are visible.

artworks.title: A Peasant Family Cooking over a Campfire
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in an outdoor setting. In the forefront, there is a woman wearing a long blue and green dress who is stirring a pot hanging over an open fire. A child with short curly hair sits nearby holding a piece of cloth. Another woman sits on a rock with a child on her lap. A young man stands near them. In the background, two women stand observing. The setting features large rocks, green trees, and a vast landscape in the distance.

artworks.title: A Peasant Family and Two Donkeys
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people and animals in a hilly landscape. There are two donkeys, one with a man carrying a swaddled baby and the other with a woman wearing a white scarf. In the background, there is a small village nestled amongst hills and trees, with a sky painted in soft blue with cloud-like brushstrokes. The style features delicate brushstrokes, giving a watercolor-like quality to the scene and emphasizing the earthy tones of the clothing and landscape.

artworks.title: Furness Abbey
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and gray ink with gray wash on light tan laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sepia-toned drawing of a ruined Gothic structure with high arches and detailed stonework, seen from a level perspective. The horizon is positioned beyond the ruins, where architectural remnants can be observed through large archways, framed by distant trees. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, capturing the lines and details of the architecture, while the foliage is depicted with soft, textured strokes. The color palette consists mainly of warm browns and grays. Closest to us, various trees frame the drawing on both sides, with the central ruin slightly to the left. In the distance, more trees and structural elements appear gradually less defined, emphasizing the depth of the scene.

artworks.title: A Male Nude Seen from Behind
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a male figure seen from the back. The person is kneeling on a block with one knee while the other leg is extended behind. Both arms are raised above the head, holding a rope or similar object. The figure's back, arms, and legs are muscular, and the hair is medium-length and wavy. The figure is unclothed, and there are no additional objects or jewelry present. The background is a uniformly textured surface.

artworks.title: Venetian Capriccio with a Campanile
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a low angle view looking across a calm body of water towards a distant cityscape. The horizon is placed just below the middle of the composition, featuring a skyline with a prominent tall bell tower and architectural structures spread across the view. The painting's technique uses soft, fluid brushstrokes that blend seamlessly into one another. The color palette is composed of muted tones, with grays and blues predominating, while soft pastel hues of peach, pink, and orange highlight the buildings and sailboats along the waterline, creating a subtle contrast against the dusky sky.

artworks.title: Temple of Vesta at Tivoli
artworks.medium: watercolor heightened with white gouache over graphite on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a classical building surrounded by smaller structures. The painting has loose brushstrokes and a color palette of warm tones, with hints of green and blue-gray. Vegetation is depicted with loose strokes in greens and browns. The sky is a blend of brown and blue hues.

artworks.title: Gondolas Before a Palace on the Grand Canal in Venice
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a grand building that dominates the scene, taking up much of the composition. The horizon line is blurred into the water with reflections from the architecture and boats. Gondolas or similar boats are observed on the reflective surface, with gentle strokes indicating movement. The technique features loose and expressive brushstrokes that suggest forms. The color palette includes soft tones of beige, muted oranges, and hints of blue for the building and sky, and darker and warmer tones for the boats and reflections. The overall effect is impressionistic, capturing the essence of the scene with minimal detail but a strong visual impact.

artworks.title: Palaces on the Grand Canal in Venice
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with white heightening over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view overlooking a series of architectural structures. There is a larger, more detailed building on the left with smaller, less detailed structures on the right. The painting features loose, impressionistic brushstrokes with a warm color palette dominated by beige, blues, and hints of red.

artworks.title: A Cornfield at Sunset
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with black chalk over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape consisting of trees, harvested crops, and a horizon with the setting sun behind distant hills. A cluster of trees is on the left side with a textured appearance. The color scheme includes earthy tones, oranges, reds, lavender, and blues. Sheaves of crops are visible in the foreground, leading towards the horizon.

artworks.title: A Campanile among Ruins
artworks.medium: gouache and watercolor with white heightening over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a bird's-eye view of a landscape with an elongated, cylindrical tower positioned off-center to the right. The horizon sits about a third from the top of the painting, separating a sky with soft blue and light beige tones. Earthy brown and greenish streaks imply buildings and foliage closer to us. The loose brushstrokes convey movement and atmosphere. Further out, the landscape features muted cream and gray hues, suggesting distant towns or structures. Warm earthy tones and soft blues dominate the color palette, creating a tranquil and expansive visual effect.

artworks.title: A Landscape with Mountains and a Stream
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with loosely painted features. The horizon is low, with hills or mountains in soft blues and greys. The painting style uses fluid watercolor brushstrokes, creating a dreamy effect. Earthy tones and splashes of color suggest a beach or shoreline setting. The color palette is airy, with blues, beiges, and whites dominating. The sky is expansive, light, and minimally clouded, contributing to the serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Salute and the Palazzo Ducale from the Bacino di San Marco
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, and pastel over graphite on gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view across a body of water, likely depicting a cityscape at a distance. The horizon line is low, marked by faint silhouettes of architectural forms with soft edges. The horizon features blurred structures, possibly buildings or monuments, rendered in smudged brushstrokes blending seamlessly. The color palette is muted with shades of gray dominating the sky, and hints of warm tones like soft yellows and reds on the structures. In the water close by, cool blue tones create a reflection of the skyline.

artworks.title: A Gondola Passing Under a Bridge in Venice
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from above. The horizon is in the middle of the canvas, with water stretching across. Faint architectural forms suggesting buildings are visible on the left and right edges. The brushwork is soft and fluid, creating an ethereal quality. The color palette includes light blues, sandy beiges, and darker tones for detail. The watercolor technique gives a transparent, delicate appearance to the scene.

artworks.title: Walls of a North African City
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image offers an elevated perspective showing the ground, buildings in the distance, and a relatively high horizon. A white building with purple and yellow hues is prominent. Loose and fluid brushstrokes give an impressionistic feel. The color palette includes soft pastels and vibrant accents, with light blues in the sky and hints of yellow, purple, and pink on the structures. Figures in red are seen near us, adding touches of liveliness. The scene conveys a sense of space and depth under the expansive sky.

artworks.title: Rosemary No. 1
artworks.medium: watercolor with black chalk and graphite on wove paper laid down on board, with a borderline in soft graphite? by the artist and squared for transfer in pen and red ink
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with farm buildings surrounded by vegetation. Rolling hills, fields, and trees are seen stretching into the distance. The color palette includes muted greens and browns with darker outlines. A grid overlay is visible on the image.

artworks.title: The Plantation
artworks.medium: charcoal on with graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky landscape with a large rock formation and tall, slender trees. The trees are on the left side, with their tops reaching towards the sky. The horizon is not visible due to the rocks and vegetation. The pencil strokes create texture, with varying pressure indicating foliage and rocks for depth. The color palette is grayscale with blacks and grays emphasizing shadows. Near the trees on the left, there are barely visible steps or a platform. The rocks extend into the distance, gradually becoming less distinct.

artworks.title: Across Bolham Water
artworks.medium: charcoal on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated vantage point. The horizon features hills and a distant structure. In the foreground, there are cows grazing in sections of a field. The composition transitions into open fields and hills leading to the horizon. The artwork is rendered in monochrome, with varying intensities of black and gray, creating a serene scene.

artworks.title: The Pantheon
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with watercolor and gouache over red chalk on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 10.4 x 13.8 cm (4 1/8 x 5 7/16 in.), oval
artworks.description: The image features an elevated viewpoint looking towards the front of the Pantheon, centrally placed within the composition. The horizon aligns with the rooftops of the surrounding buildings and the top of the Pantheon, emphasizing it as the focal point. The brushstrokes are fine and precise, capturing the intricate details of the architecture and urban landscape in a neoclassical style. The color palette is warm, dominated by beige, ochre, and light browns contrasting with the soft blue sky. A fountain with an obelisk is in the foreground, with the Pantheon and scattered figures beyond. Residential buildings frame the scene in the distance, enhancing symmetry, while soft clouds fill the sky.

artworks.title: A Painter's Studio with a Model Wrapped in Japanese Silk
artworks.medium: black chalk, watercolor, and gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a red folding chair, with her upper body turned towards an easel to the right. Her arms are crossed over her chest, and she has an elegant updo with loose strands framing her face. She is draped in a blue fabric with a floral pattern. Surrounding her are several large books or portfolios, and some sheets of paper are scattered on the floor. In the background, there is a lightly sketched image on the wall, a guitar hanging next to a framed picture on the left. The setting appears to be an artist's studio, with a plain wall and a wooden floor.
